title: The Suez Canal's early years, under the shadow of the French and British empires
subhead: 'Suez, a historic canal' (3/6). From 1880 to 1914, Egypt received less than 1% of the revenue generated by the Suez Canal Company. That income illustrated the United Kingdom's and France's domination of the waterway's management at the beginning of the 20th century.
